demo|/medications/68dbdb67-6c36-4318-9e4.name: CRESTOR
demo|/medications/68dbdb67-6c36-4318-9e4.directions: Take 1 tab/s every morning For cholesterol lowering

explanation.purpose: Crestor (rosuvastatin) is used to lower blood cholesterol levels and help prevent heart attacks and strokes. It works by reducing the amount of cholesterol made by your liver. It also helps your body remove bad cholesterol from your blood.
explanation.tellDoctor: Contact your doctor or pharmacist promptly if you have unexplained muscle pain, tenderness, or weakness, especially with dark tea-coloured urine or a fever. You should also seek medical advice soon if you notice yellowing of your skin or eyes, severe stomach pain, or swelling of your face, lips, or tongue.

demo|/medications/5723bc6c-2ae0-49c7-b39.name: PARACETAMOL
demo|/medications/5723bc6c-2ae0-49c7-b39.directions: TAKE 2 TAB/S 4 times a day FOR FEVER/PAIN TAKE AFTER FOOD

explanation.purpose: PARACETAMOL is used to relieve everyday pain and bring down fever. It works by reducing pain messages and helping the body cool down.
explanation.tellDoctor: Contact your doctor or pharmacist soon if you notice a skin rash, swelling of your face or throat, or trouble breathing. Reach out right away if you develop yellow skin or eyes, dark urine, or severe stomach pain.

explanation.purpose: Atorvastatin lowers cholesterol in your blood to help protect your heart and blood vessels. It works by reducing the amount of cholesterol made by your liver.
explanation.tellDoctor: Contact your doctor or pharmacist quickly if you have unexplained muscle pain or weakness, dark urine, yellowing of your skin or eyes, or a skin rash.

mr-tan|/medications/ad2914b5-9222-5305-b.directions: An antibiotic for a chest infection, 7 days.

explanation.purpose: Clarithromycin is an antibiotic medicine used to treat bacterial infections, including chest infections. It works by stopping bacteria from growing and multiplying in the body.
sideEffects: A bitter or metallic taste in the mouth
explanation.tellDoctor: Contact your doctor or pharmacist soon if you get a skin rash, swelling of your face or throat, yellow skin or eyes, or severe watery diarrhea. You should also seek medical attention right away if you have trouble breathing or a fast, irregular heartbeat.

explanation.purpose: Fish oil is commonly taken to support heart health and lower fats in the blood called triglycerides. Scientific evidence for its health benefits is limited, and it is not checked like a prescription medicine. It works by supplying omega-3 fatty acids, which help reduce the amount of fats made in your body.
explanation.tellDoctor: Contact your doctor or pharmacist soon if you notice unusual bleeding, frequent nosebleeds, or easy bruising. Reach out quickly if you notice signs of an allergic reaction, such as a rash or swelling of your face, lips, or throat.

mr-tan|/medications/8420e826-45eb-56c2-b.directions: Helps the body use insulin better and lowers sugar. Take with food.

explanation.purpose: Metformin is used to treat type 2 diabetes. It helps lower your blood sugar by helping your body use insulin better. It also lowers the amount of sugar made by your liver.
sideEffects: A metallic taste in the mouth
explanation.tellDoctor: Contact your doctor or pharmacist soon if you have yellow skin or eyes, severe stomach pain, unusual muscle cramps, or extreme tiredness with trouble breathing. Seek medical help right away if you get a skin rash, or swelling of your face, lips, or throat.
